blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — San Miguel Global Power Holdings Corp. (SMGP) reported new gains of P2.19 billion after selling about a 0.33-percent stake in Manila Electric Co. (Meralco) to billionaire Manuel V. Pangilinan. In a regulatory filing, its parent firm, San Miguel Corp. (SMC), announced the closing of the sale of 3.77 million common shares in Meralco to Pangilinan, the power firm’s chair. The shares were priced at P580.99 each. READ: Pangilinan buys Meralco shares from San Miguel group for P2.19B The shares crossed through the Philippine Stock Exchange on Friday.
